repos_data.description: This is a repository of themes for GNU ls (configured via GNU dircolors) that support Ethan Schoonover’s Solarized color scheme.
A delicate dircolors theme for ls that injects color without overwhelming your workspace - macOS friendly 

repo_meta_data.description: Gogh is a collection of color schemes for various terminal emulators, including Gnome Terminal, Pantheon Terminal, Tilix, and XFCE4 Terminal also compatible with iTerm on macOS.
